description: Guía de Estudios Geotécnicos para Edificación y Urbanización en la Comunitat Valenciana: Zonas eólicas CTE is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by terramapas.icv.gva.es. Representation of the wind zones in the Valencian Community, at a scale of 1:50,000, belonging to the Valencian Building Institute. Published in the "Guide to Geotechnical Studies for Building and Urbanization" which is a recognized document for Quality in Building with code DRB 02/10. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Guide to Geotechnical Studies for Building and Urban Development in the Valencian Community: CTE wind zones" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Comunitat Valenciana, IDEV, Vivenda, ICV_CLAS:Información geocientífica, ICV_CLAS:Informació geocientífica, Geología. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2006-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
